svg.title: YOLO dense detector 的相鄰方法比較圖
svg.desc: 三種相關方法並排，比較它們的它如何形成候選與會交出什麼 box evidence；底部標示共同的人工 review 邊界。

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif
Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 比 query／candidate 與 box 輸出

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 偵測模型的取捨來自候選如何形成、哪些框被保留，以及輸出如何回到原始 ROI 與 review。

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif
Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

g.data-must-show: YOLO dense detector：依據：multi-scale feature locations 上的版本指定 box/class/objectness dense candidates | candidate output: 可用輸出：decode/filter/NMS/inverse map 後的 known-class boxes/ROI crops | Same input, ROI, preprocess, truth, and evidence gate; do not switch the comparison contract.
g.data-not-claim: YOLO dense detector output is a candidate, not verified field truth; still use the evidence gate.
g.title: YOLO dense detector：依據：multi-scale feature locations 上的版本指定 box/class/objectness dense candidates

g.data-must-show: RT-DETR：依據：hybrid encoder 後選出的有限 object queries/reference points 與 set detection contract | candidate output: 可用輸出：decoder layers 產生的 class/box set；每個 depth/runtime 要另驗 P95 | Same input, ROI, preprocess, truth, and evidence gate; do not switch the comparison contract.
g.data-not-claim: RT-DETR output is a candidate, not verified field truth; still use the evidence gate.
g.title: RT-DETR：依據：hybrid encoder 後選出的有限 object queries/reference points 與 set detection contract
